text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Weights and Measures (Fees) Regulations. Interpretation.
In these Regulations, an “inspector” means an inspector appointed under section 4 and includes a Senior Inspector and Chief Inspector. Fees.

The fees shown in the Schedule are the fees which an inspector may charge in respect of registration, inspection, testing or calibration of weights and measures instruments. 4 CAP. 151, Rg 2 Weights and Measures (regulation 3) FEES

WEIGHTS AND MEASURES INSTRUMENTS Type of Registration and instrument stamping fee Reverification fee Calibration fee $ $ $ Spring Balance 0 — 50 kg 10 5 5 50 — 200 kg 10 5 10 Dacing (Gold) 10 5 5 Linear measurement 2 1 2 Counterpoise/ 2 1 1 Test weight (each) Petrol pump 10 5 5 (per meter) (per test) Liquid measurements 5 3 2 Electronic balance or scales 0 — 200 kg 15 8 10 Flow meter 15 10 200 (per meter)

WEIGHING MACHINES IN WHICH CAPACITY ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THIS LIST, THE FEES WILL BE AS FOLLOWS — Above 1 m/tonne 15 10 375 (per tonne) (per tonne) Below 1 m/tonne 15 8 50 FEES — (continued) OTHER FEES —

(1) Replacement for lost Registration Card $2.

(2) Transportation fees for test weights using Government of Brunei Darussalam vehicle — $100 — Brunei and Muara District $150 — Tutong District $200 — Belait District
